definitions.short: Uthai , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5793. Uthay עוּתַי proper name, masculine 1. name in Judah 1Chr 9:4 , Γωθει (= עֲתָיָה Neh 11:4 ). 2 Ezra 8:14 , Ουθι . עֻזָּא עֹז, עַז, see עזז . עֵז see ענז . p. 738-39, 777

occurrences.englishText: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
